capabilities: read RSS and Atom feeds in a docked sidebar with read/unread, favorite and archive states
follow WeChat official accounts via WeChat Read login and an optional local collection engine
save articles as Markdown notes with dated filenames and cloud image links
manage subscriptions with groups, refresh intervals, OPML and JSON import/export
expose a local RSS address that other readers can subscribe to
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is a full RSS/Atom reader; WeChat official account support is an optional engine that must be installed separately.
extras: The WeChat engine only supports macOS Apple Silicon; the plugin downloads a fixed ~45.5 MiB engine from GitHub after explicit user confirmation (SHA-256 verified) and the README notes that whether user-initiated executable downloads meet community directory policy is not officially confirmed. Plain RSS/Atom works with the standard three plugin files and no engine.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to subscribe to RSS/Atom feeds or WeChat official accounts and turn articles into Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: 旧版采集实现参考并保留 wechat-mp-tools 的 MIT 许可

summary: RSS reader sidebar that manages RSS, Atom and WeChat official account feeds, reads articles in a modal, and archives them as Markdown notes.
